qualifications: The forward operating plan (Property-and-Plan.pdf p.2) is a supplied underwriting scenario, not a lender-approved forecast; it has not been forced to equal T12 actuals or annualized point-in-time rent roll.

Insurance: the plan asserts an insurer renewal confirmation at $27,600 but no insurer document is in the packet. The $27,600 is used in underwriting as instructed yet reported as an unverified plan allowance; verified_renewal_insurance is null. T12 actual was $25,200.

Suite 101 has three documents of differing authority. The executed first amendment ($7,500/month; expiry and deposit unchanged) controls; the rent roll ($7,000) is stale and the unsigned 2026-08-27 broker proposal ($8,000, extension to 2033) is excluded from all rent, expiry and underwriting figures.
The suite 101 renewal option is not evidenced as exercised, so the expiry remains 2031-08-31.

Indicative value is the lender's capitalization convention (UW NOI before reserves / 6.50%); no appraisal, environmental report, property condition report, market comparables, tenant financials, sponsor/guarantor information, title or credit approval is supplied.

DSCR binds exactly at 1.25x, so proceeds are highly sensitive to underwritten NOI. On historical T12 NCF ($498,400) coverage against sizing debt service would be about 1.15x, below the lender minimum.

Rollover and vacancy: suite 106 (21.7% of area) expires 2027-08-31 inside the 60-month term and suite 108 (12.2% of area) is vacant; no leasing capital, TI or downtime reserve is underwritten because none is supplied.

Origination fee is 1.00% of actual initial principal; no fee capitalization, interest reserve, cash sweep, earn-out or holdback is assumed. Intermediate values are unrounded; displayed dollars are rounded for readers.
Rates and ratios are decimals; occupancy figures are percent 0-100 per the field specifications.
